remarks: Tucked away in the sought-after Hawthorne condominium complex in the Glenville area of Greenwich you will find this immaculate 1 bedroom / 1 full bath end unit. This stunning garden ranch condo offers a cheery updated kitchen with granite countertops, newer pretty white appliances and an office nook with plenty of cabinets, a laundry room off of the kitchen provides additional storage and a sunny and large living/dining area. The primary bedroom is bright and airy with ample closets. Enough storage for all of your needs. The full bath has a spa inspired jetted tub - indulge and let the day melt away. Relax on your private patio surrounded by meticulous landscaping. Off street parking provides plenty of spaces for both you and your guests. Minutes to the quaint village of Glenville where you will find popular shops (Coming Soon ~ DeCicco Market), restaurants & parks. Convenient to all surrounding Greenwich amenities & major routes & Westchester Airport! Simply move in, unpack and enjoy the easy life of condo living. Added bonus; new HVAC, low common fee, newly painted, new stove & dishwasher & other finishing touches makes this home a must see!
